LESSON: VISUAL DISCRIMINATION

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.4: Visual discrimination

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Visual discrimination. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Match and pair pictures and puzzles among other visual objects at home and at school. discrimination activities

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Match and pair pictures and puzzles among other visual objects at home and at school. discrimination activities
   In simple words: practise until you can match and pair pictures and puzzles among other visual objects at home and at school. discrimination activities. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Visual discrimination using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Visual discrimination in the examples.
2. Explain Visual discrimination to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Visual discrimination.
4. Show that you can: Match and pair pictures and puzzles among other visual objects at home and at school. discrimination activities

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Visual discrimination using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Visual discrimination important for a PP2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Match and pair pictures and puzzles among other visual objects at home and at school. discrimination activities

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
